audit_items.proof_trace: `ObligationOwnerCap` has `key, store` abilities enabling native Sui transfer; all lending operations (borrow, withdraw, repay, deposit) authenticate solely via cap possession using `obligation_owner_cap.id()` with no `ctx.sender()` check against any stored owner address. After `transfer::public_transfer(cap, recipient)`, Sui's object model immediately grants the recipient exclusive ability to include the cap in transactions, providing full borrow/withdraw/repay authority with no lockout period or revocation path.
